lines.text: Many learners say: I have a good news for you.
Better: I have good news for you.
News is one thing, but we do not use a with it.
Good news! I have good news.

data.wrong: I have a good news for you.
data.right: I have good news for you.
data.why: News is one thing, but we do not use a with it.

native.tip: En français, on dit « une nouvelle ». En anglais, “news” ne prend jamais “a”.
native.caption: Vous dites “I have a good news for you.” ? En français, « nouvelle » prend « une ». En anglais, “news” ne prend jamais “a” : “good news”. Dites plutôt “I have good news for you.” — écoutez Ama et répétez avec elle ! Plus d’exercices dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.tip: In English, “news” never takes “a”. Just say “good news”.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I have a good news for you.” In English, “news” never takes “a”. Just say “good news”. Say “I have good news for you.” Listen to Ama and repeat with her! More exercises in the Lexkite app.
